source.author: Golden Media / Opticum (XWindow GUI build)
source.note: Archive xwindow_gm_1.5.13_x4_oldremote.zip from the Opticum / Opticum HD X402-X403-X4-X7 directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-02.

simulator.note: Boots as an M3602B board (chips/m3602.py, lemontree_decoder.py, run_dump_gm_unibox_xwindow_app_starts.py, run_dump_gm_unibox_xwindow_capture_screen.py): the "M3602B 1.1.6" bootloader communicates with the external Lemontree front-panel and EuP standby microcontroller at I2C 0x28 on bit-banged SCL = GPIO 62 / SDA = GPIO 171 using 8-byte CRC-16/XMODEM frames (updating the 4-digit 7-segment display " ON " -> "    " -> " on "), prints "APP  init ok", unpacks maincode(AV) to 0x80008000, and starts the single-CPU application.  The application configures the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33 and Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60, and without the board's anti-clone security IC renders its XWindow OSD dialog through GeM3602 (8 GE commands, 19 colours).

desc: Golden Media Uni-Box 9060 / 9080 CRCI HD PVR Class / Opticum HD X4-series (System ID 06020200) firmware 1.5.13 with the XWindow GUI and old remote table (2012-03-18) on a 4 MB SPI flash for the ALi M3602B Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver.

Uses the external Lemontree EuP standby and 4-digit 7-segment front-panel microcontroller at I2C 0x28 on GPIO 62 / 171 (CRC-16/XMODEM protocol, " ON " -> " on "), an ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33, an Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60, and a 38-entry 0x80xx remote control table ("necfirst" coding).
